At Ooh La La Pet Spaw & Hotel our guests enjoy all-day playgroups and are tucked away each night in their individual standard or luxury suites, where they sleep on raised comfy beds and have a soft fleece blankie.
We’ll do everything we can to ensure your dog is happy and healthy during their stay and you can feel confident knowing your dog will be well loved in our safe and secure environment.
Facilities are monitored 24 hours a day, 7 days a week by live cameras
Please see our requirements to stay that helps keep your furbaby protected. Please bring your furbaby's own food when you come to stay, as to not upset his/her belly.
